test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: The population of a place increased to 50,000 from 2016 to 2018 at the rate of 6% per annum, and continued the same trend for the next 3 years. If A is the population in 2016 and B is the population in 2020, both are approximated to the next possible integers, then the value of B - A is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective % increase for 2 years at 6% p.a. = 6 + 6 + (6 × 6)/100 = 12.36%

Multiplying factor for 2 years = 1.1236

Population in 2020 (B) = 50,000 × 1.1236 = 56,180

Population in 2016 (A) = 50,000 ÷ 1.1236 ≈ 44,500 (approximated to next integer)

Difference B − A = 56,180 − 44,500 = 11,680

**∴ The correct answer is 11680.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Population in 2018 = 50,000

Rate of increase = 6% per annum

A = Population in 2016, B = Population in 2020

**Formula Used:**

Population after n years = Initial Population × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fae66212a750593d823f133ea9e92ac0a787a3c7b814fc622751b7da19cb3f5.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time period from 2016 to 2018 = 2 years

⇒ 50,000 = A × (1 + 6/100)²

⇒ A = 50,000 ÷ 1.1236 = 44499.82 ≈ 44,500

⇒ Time period from 2018 to 2020 = 2 years

⇒ B = 50,000 × (1 + 6/100)²

⇒ B = 50,000 × 1.1236 = 56,180

⇒ Value of B − A = 56,180 − 44,500 = 11,680

**∴ The correct answer is 11680.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value changes successively by a% and then b%, the effective percentage change is calculated as: a + b + (a × b) / 100.

Population Growth Formula

If the initial population is P and it grows at a compound rate of R% per annum, the population after n years is given by: P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ.

Depreciation Formula

If the value or population decreases at R% per annum, the value after n years is given by: P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ.
